archiveTitle: 日报｜《Wild Arms》团队新作出现取消披露

decisions.headline: 《Wild Arms》团队新作《ARMED FANTASIA》被 Digital Bros 财报列为开发中止
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON 报道，Digital Bros 于当地时间9月24日公布的年度财报将《ARMED FANTASIA》列入相关开发中止项目。该作由《Wild Arms》创作者参与制作；截至文章发表，开发商 WILD BUNCH Productions 尚未自行宣布取消，因此不能把发行集团的披露写成开发团队已确认终止整个项目。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Digital Bros lists ARMED FANTASIA cancellation

entries.headline: Digital Bros financial report lists ARMED FANTASIA development as cancelled
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Digital Bros listed ARMED FANTASIA among cancelled development projects in its annual report published on September 24 local time. Creators of Wild Arms are involved in the game. At the time of the article, developer WILD BUNCH Productions had not itself announced cancellation; the publisher group’s disclosure does not establish that the developer has confirmed the entire project is over.

entries.headline: Ace Attorney 5 VR announced for Meta VR devices in 2027
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Amata announced the Capcom-licensed Ace Attorney 5 VR on September 24. It is planned for 2027 on Meta Quest 3, 3S, 2, Pro and Meta VR Glasses. Hand tracking lets players take the role of Phoenix Wright and present evidence in court.

entries.headline: Luma Island announces PS5 version with four-player cross-platform co-op
entries.summary: Feel Free Games announces on PlayStation Blog that Luma Island is coming to PS5. Players can build, farm and explore alone or in online groups of up to four, with cross-platform play across PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC. The original announcement gives no PS5 release date.
